description: The pie chart represents the distribution of data sources in a combined training dataset. The chart is divided into 12 slices, each representing a different data source. The slices are labeled with abbreviations such as NQ (blue, 31.3%), FEVE (grey, 16.1%), SNLI (orange, 15.4%), VITAMINC (light orange, 13.0%), MULTINLI (pink, 11.3%), TJEC (red, 5.7%), ANLI (dark orange, 4.6%), FACTCC (green, 2.6%), ENTFA (yellow, 1.8%), SCITAIL (purple, 1.2%), PUBHEALTH (light purple, 0.5%), and SCIFACT (dark green, 0.1%). The chart includes percentage labels next to each slice, and the slices are arranged in a clockwise direction without any apparent ordering by size. No legend is present, and none of the slices are visually emphasized.
